home.heroTitle: Your CV and what HR needs,
home.heroBody: SkillSync connects a candidate's potential with what recruiters actually need — helping candidates build a stronger CV, and helping HR validate real ability beyond what fits on paper.
home.cardCaseQuestion: How do you prioritise a critical bug when the release date is close?
home.featuresTitle: From claims on a CV to proven ability.
home.featuresBody: SkillSync joins the candidate's journey and HR's in one system, so applying isn't the finish line — it's where evidence-based validation starts.
home.feature1Body: Turn raw experience into a structured, ATS-friendly CV — action verbs, measurable impact, and STAR formatting included.
home.feature2Body: Paste a job description and SkillSync writes adaptive case-study questions around the role's key qualifications.
home.feature3Body: Compare CV claims against assessment evidence — with a 1–100 match score and an AI pitch summary.
home.howTitle: Three steps from claim to evidence.
home.howBody: The same flow runs on both sides — candidates apply, SkillSync verifies, HR decides with evidence.
home.how1Body: Candidates turn raw experience into an ATS-ready CV, then apply to roles that fit their profile.
home.how2Body: A short, role-specific case-study simulation checks whether the CV's claims hold up in practice.
home.how3Body: HR sees a scorecard ranking candidates by CV fit and real verification transcripts — not just a résumé.
home.rolesBody: Pick the journey that matches where you stand — one brand and one system connecting both ends of hiring.
home.roleCandidateBody: Build a stronger CV, find roles that fit, apply, then prove your ability in a short case-study simulation.
home.roleHrBody: Generate role-specific assessments and see candidates ranked with both CV data and real assessment evidence.
home.testimonialsTitle: Built by people tired of guessing.
home.testimonialsBody: Early feedback from candidates and recruiting teams trying SkillSync.
home.t1Quote: My CV used to be a list of duties. SkillSync helped me explain the impact, and I walked into my first interview far more confident.
home.t2Quote: Screening that took two weeks now takes two days. The verification score means we interview fewer people, but the right ones.
home.t3Quote: The case-study questions actually match the JD instead of being generic. You can see who really understands the work.
home.faq1A: Yes. Building a CV and taking the competency verification is free for every candidate — SkillSync charges the HR teams doing the hiring.
home.faq2Q: How is the validation score calculated?
home.faq2A: The 1–100 score combines how well the CV matches the job description with the evaluation of the case-study answers, judged on reasoning, relevance and clarity.
home.faq3Q: Are the verification questions the same for every role?
home.faq3A: No. The AI Scenario Generator writes questions straight from the job description HR uploads, so every role gets a case study that fits it.
home.faq4A: About 3 minutes on average for three short case-study questions, and it can be done right after applying — even from a phone.
home.faq5A: No. The whole candidate journey — building the CV, applying, verifying — is designed mobile-first and works entirely on a phone.
home.ctaBody: Your CV and what HR needs — finally in sync.
home.footerTagline: An AI-powered hiring validation platform connecting candidate potential with what recruiters really need.
home.footerBuiltFor: Built to connect talent with the right opportunity.
